title: Jafar ka Rone Walon
body:
jafar ka rone waalon taboot uth raha hai
phir fatema ke ghar mein farsh e aza bicha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kazim tadap tadap kar ye bain kar rahe hai
afsos mera baba mujh se bichad gaya hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
misle hassan jigar hai jafar ka tukde tukde
haakim ne zehr haye masoom ko diya hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm seh rahe hai jafar imam e sadiq
farzande sayyeda par kaisa sitam hua hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
har zulm kalmago ne sadaat par hai dhaaya
aulaad e mustafa par ghurbat ki inteha hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid e sitam mein jafar rote hai shaah e deen ko
maula ki chashm e tar mein sehra e karbala hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
<<DIVIDER>>
keh do muhib ye jaa kar kam zarf muftiyon se
sab se badi ibadat matam e hussain ka hai
jafar ka rone waalon…
